text: range model gives probability receiver hears one transmission given distance receiver depth. detfield R package, builds detection fields positions animals, sets one two ways. detfield::de_model() wraps model fitted range-test data, detfield::de_logistic() makes stand-curve two distances study range test. example uses stand-assumed values; range test measured . takes distances 50% 5% transmissions heard (d50, d05) 250 m 500 m receiver 1 m deep 750 m 1,500 m 35 m, interpolated . Design array water body takes model fitted range test. detfield measures distance water receiver water cell reads curve , receiver hear across point land. detfield::de_field() returns detection field, one probability per receiver cell. coverage_summary() counts, threshold, cells least one receiver hears (n_cells). array whole hears cell receiver hears transmission, takes cells receivers single one reaches. chance one receivers hear one minus product misses (Pedersen et al. 2014, Methods Ecology Evolution 5: 1043-1051, DOI 10.1111/2041-210X.12255). array hears 648 cells (13.4% water) 0.5 , 636 one receiver alone. lake lies outside 50% range every receiver, array hears animals pass.  Probability least one 20 receivers hears one transmission 4,818 water cells Stoney Lake, 100 m side.
code: # Set the assumed range model: d50 and d05 for receivers 1 m and 35 m deep range_model <- detfield::de_logistic(d50 = c(250, 750), d05 = c(500, 1500),                                      depth = c(1, 35)) range_model #> <de_model> de_logistic, d50 250/750 m, d05 500/1500 m, depths 1/35 m #>   reads: distance_m, depth_m  #>   sigma: station_hour not given #>   blocked line of sight: curve read at the distance through water # Measure the distance through water from each receiver to each water cell distances <- detfield::water_distances(lake, receivers)  # Read the curve at each distance: one probability per receiver and cell field <- detfield::de_field(distances, range_model) #> 52 of 2,304 receiver-cell pairs with p >= 0.05 have land on the #>   straight line between them; with blocked = 0 the curve is read on #>   them as if the line were clear. See `blocked` in ?de_model. # Count the cells one receiver alone hears at p >= 0.5 and p >= 0.8 coverage_summary(field) #>   threshold n_cells n_water_cells     share n_receivers #> 1       0.5     636          4818 0.1320050          20 #> 2       0.8     180          4818 0.0373599          20 # Compute the chance that one or more receivers hear, per water cell array_p <- data.frame(p = 1 - apply(1 - field$p, 1, prod),                       terra::xyFromCell(lake, field$cells))  # Count the cells at p >= 0.5 under the array, and all water cells c(cells_at_0.5 = sum(array_p$p >= 0.5), water_cells = nrow(array_p)) #> cells_at_0.5  water_cells  #>          648         4818 # Take the ring colours of the positionR maps ring <- detfield::positionr_ring_colours()  # Map the array's detection probability, with the receivers on top as a dark # ring under a coloured one; the shape scale keys them ggplot(array_p, aes(x, y)) +   geom_raster(aes(fill = p)) +   detfield::scale_fill_probability(name = "Detection\nprobability") +   geom_point(data = receivers, aes(shape = "Receiver"), colour = ring[["edge"]],              size = 1.3, stroke = 0.9) +   geom_point(data = receivers, aes(shape = "Receiver"), colour = ring[["heard"]],              size = 1.3, stroke = 0.45) +   scale_shape_manual(name = NULL, values = c(Receiver = 21)) +   coord_equal(expand = FALSE) +   labs(x = "Easting (m)", y = "Northing (m)") +   detfield::annotation_scale_bar(location = "br") +   detfield::theme_positionr()

Draw wrapped Cauchy turning angles with concentration rho wrapped_cauchy <- function(n_draws) {   (stats::rcauchy(n_draws, 0, -log(hmm_rho)) + pi) %% (2 * pi) - pi } # Set the transition matrix: rows are the state at one step, columns the # Map one animal-hour: water by depth, the surface in magma from 0 to its # largest cell, the 95% region outlined, receivers that heard the animal as # yellow rings sized by their detections, silent receivers as white rings, # and the animal's true transmissions in the hour, keyed with the outline surface_map <- function(surfaces, animal, hour, lake, receivers, detections,                         truth, margin = 500) {   # Take the cells of the one surface, with their coordinates   hour_cells <- surfaces[surfaces$animal_id == animal &                            surfaces$bin_start == hour, ]   hour_cells <- cbind(hour_cells, terra::xyFromCell(lake, hour_cells$cell))    # Outline its 95% region   region <- detfield::credible_region(surfaces, level = 0.95)   region <- region[region$animal_id == animal & region$bin_start == hour, ]   outline <- terra::rast(lake)   outline[region$cell] <- 1   outline <- terra::geom(terra::as.polygons(outline), df = TRUE)    # Take the true transmissions and detections of the animal in the hour   in_hour <- function(times) times >= hour & times < hour + 3600   hour_truth <- truth[truth$animal_id == animal & in_hour(truth$datetime), ]   hour_detections <- detections[detections$animal_id == animal &                                   in_hour(detections$datetime), ]    # Count the detections per receiver in the hour   rings <- data.frame(receiver_serial = receivers$receiver_serial,                       x = receivers$x, y = receivers$y)   rings$n <- as.vector(table(factor(hour_detections$receiver_serial,                                     levels = rings$receiver_serial)))   heard <- rings[rings$n > 0, ]    # Zoom to the surface, the receivers that heard and the truth   in_view <- rbind(hour_cells[c("x", "y")], heard[c("x", "y")],                    hour_truth[c("x", "y")])   xlim <- range(in_view$x) + c(-margin, margin)   ylim <- range(in_view$y) + c(-margin, margin)    # Take the water in view, coloured by depth with the ramp of   # detfield::scale_fill_depth(). The fill scale holds the probability, so   # the depth key is an alpha scale held at 1 whose boxes take the ramp   depth_ramp <- scales::seq_gradient_pal("cornflowerblue", "blue4")   water <- terra::as.data.frame(abs(lake), xy = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)   names(water)[3] <- "depth_m"   deepest <- max(water$depth_m)   water$colour <- depth_ramp(water$depth_m / deepest)   depth_breaks <- pretty(c(0, deepest), n = 3)   depth_breaks <- depth_breaks[depth_breaks <= deepest]   water <- water[water$x > xlim[1] - 100 & water$x < xlim[2] + 100 &                    water$y > ylim[1] - 100 & water$y < ylim[2] + 100, ]    # Draw the layers   top_prob <- max(hour_cells$prob)   cell_size <- terra::res(lake)[1]   ggplot(hour_cells, aes(x, y)) +     geom_tile(data = water, aes(fill = I(.data$colour), alpha = .data$depth_m),               width = cell_size, height = cell_size) +     scale_alpha_continuous(       name = "Depth (m)", range = c(1, 1), limits = c(0, deepest),       breaks = depth_breaks,       guide = guide_legend(position = "bottom", nrow = 1, override.aes = list(         fill = depth_ramp(depth_breaks / deepest)       ))     ) +     geom_tile(aes(fill = .data$prob), width = cell_size, height = cell_size) +     detfield::scale_fill_probability(       name = "Probability\nper cell", limits = c(0, top_prob),       breaks = c(0, top_prob), labels = signif(c(0, top_prob), 2)     ) +     geom_path(data = outline, aes(group = interaction(.data$part, .data$hole),                                   colour = "95% region"), linewidth = 0.9) +     detfield::layer_receivers(rings, count = "n", size = 3, max_size = 9) +     geom_point(data = hour_truth[hour_truth$n_detections == 0, ],                aes(colour = "Not heard"), shape = 4, size = 1.6, stroke = 0.7) +     geom_point(data = hour_truth[hour_truth$n_detections > 0, ],                aes(colour = "Heard"), shape = 21, fill = "#2ECC40", size = 2,                stroke = 0.3) +     scale_colour_manual(       name = NULL, breaks = c("95% region", "Heard", "Not heard"),       values = c(`95% region` = "#00A087", Heard = "black", `Not heard` = "red3")     ) +     coord_equal(xlim = xlim, ylim = ylim, expand = FALSE) +     labs(title = sprintf("Animal %s, %s to %s UTC", animal,                          format(hour, "%H:%M", tz = "UTC"),                          format(hour + 3600, "%H:%M", tz = "UTC")),          x = "Easting (m)", y = "Northing (m)") +     detfield::annotation_scale_bar(location = "br") +     detfield::theme_positionr() } # Take the most-heard animal-hour with the lowest share inside its region poor_hour <- most_heard[which.min(most_heard$in_region), ] poor_hour #>   animal_id           bin_start receivers_heard n_truth error_mean_m #> 1         1 2025-01-01 04:00:00               3      24      458.342 #>   in_region #> 1 0.1666667 # Map the poor hour from the surfaces of this section surface_map(surfaces, poor_hour$animal_id, poor_hour$bin_start, lake,             receivers, sim$detections, truth)
